cohort: 50 pregnant women with clinically suspected IUGR
finding: MCA Doppler velocimetry showed higher sensitivity (92%) than UA (76.92%) in predicting fetal hypoxia in fetuses with IUGR.
mod_finding: CPR <1 combined with BSE resulted in 80% vaginal deliveries.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight increased by 4 times with AEDF & REDF compared to high S/D
